description.value:
Only slightly more efficient than pepper spray. The favorite of danger-seeking journalists.

Category: V. Expensive • Fabrication: DV24 - 1,000eb - 2 Weeks

Class: Iconic EQ Heavy Pistol • Skill: Handgun • Range: Pistol

Damage: 3d6 • Capacity: 10 • ROF: 2 • Hands: 1

Alt. Firing Modes: None

Concealable: Yes, but at a -2 penalty to Conceal/Reveal Object

Slots: N/A • Attachments: Power Rebuild, TUp (Does not require Interface Plugs or Subdermal Grip) Smartgun Link • Mods: None

Special Features: When using this weapon to make an Aimed Shot, it deals 1d6 additional damage (4d6). When firing this weapon, the user ignores all Critical Injury and Wound State related Attack Check penalties they are currently suffering (if any). While the user is in the Mortally Wounded Wound State and rolls for damage with this weapon, 4s and 5s count as 6s for the purposes of incurring Critical Injuries.

Fabrication: DV24 - 1,000eb - 2 Weeks
Range: Pistol
Pre-installed: Power Rebuild, TUp (Does not require Interface Plugs or Subdermal Grip) Smartgun Link (effects already included in these stats)

Foundry notes:

  • Iconic weapons follow the Exotic weapon rules: no Non-Basic Ammunition and no Attachment Slots unless this entry says otherwise.
  • Iconic: it can't be bought or sourced on the street, can't be fabricated without its Blueprint, can't be taken during Character Generation, and once acquired can't be destroyed unless the player agrees to it beforehand.

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Becoming Iconic > Iconic Weapons).
